title: Spiritual Gifts, One Body with Many Members

questions.question: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:1 (ESV): "Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed."

questions.question: Therefore I want you to understand that no one speaking in the Spirit of God ever says "Jesus is accursed!" and no one can say "Jesus is Lord" except in the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:3 (ESV): "Therefore I want you to understand that no one speaking in the Spirit of God ever says 'Jesus is accursed!' and no one can say 'Jesus is Lord' except in the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:4 (ESV): "Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;"

questions.question: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:7 (ESV): "To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good."

questions.question: Paul lists several gifts. Which of the following is NOT explicitly listed in 1 Corinthians 12:8-10?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:8-10 lists wisdom, knowledge, faith, healing, miracles, prophecy, distinguishing between spirits, tongues, and interpretation. "Administrating" is mentioned later in verse 28, but not in this specific list of manifestations.

questions.question: All these are empowered by one and the same Spirit, who apportions to each one individually as he ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:11 (ESV): "All these are empowered by one and the same Spirit, who apportions to each one individually as he wills."

questions.question: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:12 (ESV): "For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ."

questions.question: For in one Spirit we were all ____ into one body—Jews or Greeks, slaves or free—and all were made to drink of one Spirit.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:13 (ESV): "For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—Jews or Greeks, slaves or free—and all were made to drink of one Spirit."

questions.question: For the body does not consist of one member but of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:14 (ESV): "For the body does not consist of one member but of many."

questions.question: If the foot should say, "Because I am not a ____, I do not belong to the body," that would not make it any less a part of the body.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:15 (ESV): "If the foot should say, 'Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,' that would not make it any less a part of the body."

questions.question: If the whole body were an eye, where would be the sense of ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:17 (ESV): "If the whole body were an eye, where would be the sense of hearing? If the whole body were an ear, where would be the sense of smell?"

questions.question: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you," nor again the head to the ____, "I have no need of you."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:21 (ESV): "The eye cannot say to the hand, 'I have no need of you,' nor again the head to the feet, 'I have no need of you.'"

questions.question: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:22 (ESV): "On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,"

questions.question: If one member suffers, all suffer together; if one member is honored, all ____ together.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:26 (ESV): "If one member suffers, all suffer together; if one member is honored, all rejoice together."

questions.question: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second ____, third teachers...
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 12:28 (ESV): "And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, administrating, and various kinds of tongues."

key_verse_text: Now you are the body of Christ and individually members of it.
